doc: Data for tests/transfer_types.rs. `types`: every source type against both dialects with exactly
one outcome (exact, widened, text_fallback, refuse) and the DDL. `values`: for one column and one
source/target pair, each value either `ok` with the text the target takes, or `refuse` with the rule.
A PostgreSQL target writes `copy` (the field as it appears in the COPY stream, escapes included);
a MySQL target writes the bound parameter as {text|int|uint|float|bytes|null}.
Types: {base, precision, scale, length, unsigned, time_zone, fraction_digits, element, oid, native}.
C-1: money is refused. C-2: the closed PostgreSQL spellings are forwarded PostgreSQL to
PostgreSQL only. B-4: only the variant a type is read as is accepted.
